creator: Codex, original vector artwork created for this repository
rights: Original project artwork; no external images, stock assets, tracing, fonts, or network resources included. Repository licensing governs redistribution.
artDirection: 现代旅行手册与中国园林版画：米色纸面、青绿瓦顶、赭红梁柱、玉绿色水面、竹与木的暖色。所有图层为可编辑 SVG。

assets.purpose: 四站共享教学示意地图。建筑受江南园林风格启发，不是真实店铺复刻或实地导航。

altText.zh: 园林教学地图，四处建筑由小径、池塘与曲桥相连。
altText.en: An illustrated garden with four learning destinations connected by paths, a pond, and a zigzag bridge.

assets.responsiveUse: Render complete viewBox on small screens and provide the separate accessible destination list. Do not crop away a required destination or rely on illustration for hit targets.
assets.textPolicy: No baked labels or actionable text; parent UI supplies localized destination names and keyboard-operable controls.

assets.purpose: 原创教学柜台，分层窗格、暖灯、女性店员、木柜台、竹蒸笼、小笼包与包装袋。不是门店实景复刻。

props.label: Localized accessible image description
props.pose: welcome | listening | checking | packed; default welcome

altText.zh: 温暖的木柜台后，店员微笑迎接；柜台上摆着小笼包蒸笼与外带纸袋。
altText.en: A welcoming server behind a warm wooden counter with dumpling baskets and a takeaway paper bag.

assets.responsiveUse: Use a dedicated close composition or contain the whole SVG for narrow screens; central server and dumplings remain primary. Required bag and basket actions need separate text controls.
assets.motion: Static SVG by default. Optional parent CSS may animate scene-steam; honor reduced motion. No automatic camera movement or interaction is embedded.
assets.poseLimits: welcome and listening share the raised-hand illustration; checking and packed use hands at the counter. packed closes one foreground basket. These presentation poses do not perform order updates, packing, completion, or saving.
assets.quantityPolicy: Basket contents are decorative. Front baskets are environment props, not a current order or a verified real-store dumpling count. Parent UI must explicitly distinguish the saved order and servings.

assets.purpose: 地图对应的四个独立建筑小图，供地点卡和回顾复用。
assets.textPolicy: Signboard ornament is decorative geometry. Actual place names are rendered by the parent UI.

accessibility: SVGs have role=img and a per-instance title ID created with React useId. Pass label in the active UI language. Images do not provide interactive controls; the parent interface supplies focusable alternatives.
fonts: None in artwork; no font files or embedded typography.

verification.sourceInspection: Original code-native shapes; no foreign assets or external URLs.
verification.visualReview: Integrated desktop (1440 viewport) and phone (390 viewport) in Chinese/English inspected in browser on 2026-10-17; English 320px overflow and button-height checked. Screenshots: docs/design/previews. This is engineering visual inspection, not user design approval or complete device/accessibility acceptance.
